description: The artifact system provides a weapon-like cosmetic+stat item (the artifact itself) plus a gem sub-system with slots, set bonuses, and attribute contribution. Artifacts have their own leveling, skin unlocking, and skill mechanics. The gem sub-system is a rune/relic-like system where gems have main attrs, sub attrs, quality, set affiliation, and leveling.

artifact_config.description: Defines individual artifact items (weapons/relics). Each artifact has visual properties, quality, and time-gated availability.

fields.name: Artifact name (string_ref)
fields.open_time: Optional time-gate array for availability [[start, end], ...]
fields.back_location_adjust: Back location adjustment for model rendering

artifact_level.description: Defines the artifact's global leveling system. Leveling up the artifact grants attribute bonuses and unlocks new artifact items.

fields.expend_exp: EXP required to reach this level
fields.attr: Attribute bonuses at this level [[attr_id, value], ...]
fields.base_skill: Base skills unlocked at this level [[skill_id, level], ...]
fields.unlock: Artifact ID unlocked at this level (0 = no unlock)

leveling_logic.code: var a = configArtifact_level.getDataByKey(IS(t).curLevel + 1).expend_exp; if (e >= (a -= IS(t).curexp)) /* can level up */
leveling_logic.exp_item: Item ID 1017 is the artifact EXP material

unlock_check.description: Artifacts are unlocked when the player's artifact level >= the level defined in ConfigArtifact_level.unlock for that artifact's ID

artifact_skin.description: Defines skin/awakening levels for each artifact. Unlocking skins grants additional skills and attributes.

fields.skin_level: Skin level (0 = base unlock, 1+ = awakening tiers)
fields.expend: Cost to unlock this skin level [[item_id, amount], ...]
fields.skin_skill: Skills granted at this skin level [[skill_id, level], ...]
fields.attr: Attribute bonuses at this skin level [[attr_id, value], ...]
fields.power: Combat power at this skin level

state_values.1: Locked (not yet obtainable or insufficient materials)

artifact_usage.description: Players equip one artifact at a time (artifact_id), and can optionally use a different artifact appearance (use_look).

visual_integration.description: The artifact figure overrides the weapon visual if set

artifact_usage.shenqi_reference: In code, artifacts are often referred to as 'shenqi' (Chinese for 'divine weapon')

gem_system.description: The artifact gem system is a sub-system where players equip up to 6 gems in dedicated slots. Each gem has a main attribute, sub attributes, quality, set affiliation, and can be leveled up. Gems contribute stats independently from the artifact itself.

gem_slots.code: for (var r = 1; r < 7; r++) /* iterate gem slots 1-6 */

gem_data_structure.description: Each gem has the following server-side data fields

fields.quality: Quality tier (same EquipQuality enum as equipment)
fields.is_new: New flag for red dot notification

gem_slot_config.description: Defines each gem slot and its allowed main attribute group.

fields.main_attr_group: Allowed main attribute group for this slot (references ConfigArtifact_gemattr.group_id)

gem_quality.description: Defines properties for each gem quality tier.

fields.max_level: Maximum level a gem of this quality can reach
fields.mainattr_groups: Possible main attribute groups for this quality
fields.viceattr_group: Sub-attribute group ID for random selection
fields.quality_exp: Base EXP value when used as upgrade fodder

gem_attributes.description: Defines the attributes available for gems, their value ranges, and upgrade scaling.

fields.group_id: Attribute group (used by gemslot and gemquality to determine available attrs)
fields.attr_id: The actual game attribute ID (references ConfigAttribute)
fields.initial_value: Initial value range [min, max] for this attribute when generated
fields.upgrade_value: Value gained per level up [min, max]
fields.power_rate: Combat power coefficient for this attribute
fields.color: Color range for value quality display [min_good, max_good]

color_grading.description: Gem attribute values are color-coded by quality. The value range is divided into 6 tiers, mapped to colors from green (worst) to pink (best).

gem_generation.description: Defines gem generation parameters for different sources (dungeons, boxes, etc.).

gem_leveling.description: Defines EXP requirements and special events per quality and level.

fields.exp: EXP required to reach this level
fields.is_strengthen: Whether a sub-attribute is strengthened at this level (1 = yes)

params.use_list: List of gem IDs to consume as fodder
params.item_list: List of EXP items to consume
params.lock_attr: Sub-attribute index to lock/protect during upgrade

gem_sets.description: Defines gem set bonuses. When 2 or 4 gems from the same set are equipped, set bonuses activate.

fields.name: Set name (string_ref)
fields.get_way: Description of how to obtain this set

set_counting_logic.code: getStoneSuitInfo: for each pos_list entry, get gem info, count suit matches. Returns {suit_id: count, ...}
set_counting_logic.activation: 2-piece and 4-piece bonuses check independently: if (b[y] >= 4) add bonus4_attr; if (b[y] >= 2) add bonus2_attr

gem_attribute_aggregation.description: Aggregates all gem attributes across equipped gems. Base_attr values are summed by attr_id, rand_attr values are summed separately, then merged.
gem_attribute_aggregation.code_summary: For each equipped gem: sum base_attr[0] by key, sum each rand_attr by key. Merge rand_attr sums into base_attr sums where keys match. Return combined array.

gem_tabs.description: Like equipment, gems support multiple loadout tabs/presets.

gem_operations.upgrade: artifact_gem.artifact_gem_up_c2s - level up gem using fodder

gem_chapter.description: Defines dungeon chapters for acquiring gems. Each chapter has requirements, monster waves, and gem rewards.

preview_chapter.description: Preview battle chapters for testing artifact appearances before unlocking.
preview_chapter.note: Similar structure to gem_chapter but includes 'part' and 'next_part' fields for multi-stage previews.

stat_contribution_flow.description: Artifact stats contribute to total player power through multiple channels

channels.description: Global attributes from ConfigArtifact_level.attr at current level
Per-artifact attributes from ConfigArtifact_skin.attr at current skin_level
Skills from ConfigArtifact_skin.skin_skill at current skin_level
Main attribute from each equipped gem's base_attr
Random attributes from each equipped gem's rand_attr
Attribute and skill bonuses from 2-piece and 4-piece set bonuses
